preview_heading: Warriors meet Knight Riders in Providence
preview: Guyana Amazon Warriors face Trinbago Knight Riders in CPL 2026 Match 33 at Providence Stadium. The match is scheduled for Fri 11 Sep at 7pm local time.
preview_detail: Guyana retain Shimron Hetmyer, Romario Shepherd, Shai Hope and Shamar Joseph, while 10 of their 12 locally selected players come from Guyana. The 2025 champions retain a decorated core led by Sunil Narine, Nicholas Pooran, Kieron Pollard and Akeal Hosein as they pursue another title. The final playing XIs will be confirmed after the toss.
